A '''scout squadron''' was a formation of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].

==Organization==
A scout squadron was comprised of two [[Scout lance|lances]] of five [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] each, with a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] replacing the [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the command lance.<ref name="ISB" />

The larger [[scout platoon]] was made up of a scout squadron commanded by the lieutenant, and two [[line squad]]s led by a [[Sergeant major/Legends|sergeant major]]. Although the lieutenant was officially in charge of the entire platoon, tradition left the "grunts" almost exclusively to the sergeant major, while the lieutenant handled the squadron.<ref name="ISB" />

==History==
[[File:Atrtpatrol.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Lightning Squadron/Legends|Lightning Squadron]] was a scout squadron that operated [[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|AT-RTs]]]]
[[Lightning Squadron/Legends|Lightning Squadron]] was a scout squadron attached to the [[91st Mobile Reconnaissance Corps/Legends|91st Mobile Reconnaissance Corps]].<ref name="GAW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref>

This elite recon unit consisted of 10 [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] specially trained to operate [[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|All Terrain Recon Transports]]. The group was commanded by a lieutenant and could be divided into two lances of five soldiers, each led by a sergeant. A [[brevet corporal]] was second in command of each lance.<ref name="GAW" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], new challenges prompted Lightning Squadron to incorporate other vehicles, such as the [[All Terrain Personal Transport/Legends|All Terrain Personal Transport]] and the [[74-Z speeder bike/Legends|74-Z speeder bike]].<ref name="GAW" /> Despite the fact that most [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] scouts operated [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]], the members of Lighting Squadron still preferred to use their AT-RT [[Walker/Legends|walkers]].<ref name="IH" />
